{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify and remove QA rows (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = df['revenue'] == 999999.99
print(f"Number of QA rows: {qa_mask.sum()}")

# Drop them
df_clean = df[~qa_mask].copy()

# Verify the clean dataset
print(f"Clean dataset shape: {df_clean.shape}")
print(f"Channels: {df_clean['channel'].unique()}")"}
